args.description: one single large weathered boulder seen from directly beside it, strict flat side profile like a technical elevation drawing. A rounded mass of pale limestone with flat worn facets and cracks running across it, darker where it meets the ground, a patch of dry moss on one shoulder, nothing under it and nothing behind it. Warm sunlit palette of pale limestone and cool grey stone. Retro 16-bit pixel art, crisp pixels, flat readable shapes, no anti-aliasing.
